import json,hashlib,pathlib,re
r=pathlib.Path('.')
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pj='plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json'
m=json.loads((r/pj).read_text()); print('plugin.json',sha(pj)); print('keys',sorted(m.keys())); print('name',m.get('name'),'version',m.get('version'))
comp='plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml'
t=(r/comp).read_text(); print('comp sha',sha(comp))
i=t.find('external_dependencies'); print(t[i:i+800])
pc='plugins/system-spec-harness/references/package-contract.json'
c=json.loads((r/pc).read_text()); print('pc sha',sha(pc)); print('entry_points',json.dumps(c.get('entry_points'))[:800])
for s in c.get('entry_points',{}).get('skills',[]):
    n=s if isinstance(s,str) else s.get('name')
    p=r/f'plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/{n}/SKILL.md'; print(n,p.is_file(), sha(str(p)) if p.is_file() else None)
for p,h in [('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json','72bb3c7257d91b2ff1e8ed8e700740ebedd76df02108fba4b363b940480d967d'),('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json','6205a09e2f9317ce627c41a5ce34c08469da5909c1ea50562501708f819f7792')]:
    print(p, sha(p)==h)
print((r/'eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json').read_text()[:3000])
EOF
